step_by_step_reasoning:
The architecture represents Cookpad's security log monitoring system divided into three main phases: Collection, Retention, and Analysis.
1. Collection: EC2 instances send Syslog logs via Fluentd to Kinesis Data Firehose, which outputs to S3. AWS CloudTrail writes management logs directly to S3. A third-party service delivers logs via a Lambda function to S3.
2. Retention: All raw logs are collected without predefined schemas in Amazon S3, storing ~330M logs/day (~270 GB). S3 Lifecycle policies manage retention periods.
3. Analysis: S3 triggers three separate analysis mechanisms: a Lambda function for real-time alerting (sending alerts to Slack), a Lambda function for forwarding log data to Graylog backed by Amazon Elasticsearch Service (OpenSearch), and Amazon Athena querying S3 for long-term audit purposes.

graph.name: Cookpad Security Log Monitoring Architecture
graph.notes: Processes ~330M logs/day (~270 GB) at a Lambda cost of ~$2/day. Eliminates strict log schema requirements upon collection by storing raw logs directly in S3.

nodes.name: EC2
nodes.notes: Generates Syslog messages collected by Fluentd agent.

nodes.name: FIREHOSE
nodes.notes: Buffers and streams Syslog data into S3.

nodes.name: CLOUDTRAIL
nodes.notes: Directly delivers AWS audit logs into S3.

nodes.name: LAMBDA (Collection)
nodes.notes: Ingests logs from 3rd party service and saves them to S3.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Central log repository. Stores ~330M logs (~270 GB) daily without schema constraints. Retention managed via S3 Lifecycle policies.

nodes.name: LAMBDA (Alerts)
nodes.notes: Scans logs for short-term alerting and sends notifications to Slack.

nodes.name: LAMBDA (Search)
nodes.notes: Forwards processed logs to Graylog for medium/long-term search capabilities.

nodes.name: ELASTICSEARCH
nodes.notes: Amazon Elasticsearch Service serving as the backend engine for Graylog.

nodes.name: ATHENA
nodes.notes: Queries raw historical log data stored in S3 for long-term auditing.

edges.notes: EC2 sends Syslog messages to Kinesis Data Firehose using Fluentd.
Firehose delivers aggregated logs to S3.
CloudTrail directly writes audit logs to S3.
Third-party service delivers log data to Lambda.
Lambda saves third-party log data into S3.
S3 feeds or triggers Lambda for real-time alert processing.
S3 delivers log data to Lambda for search indexing preparation.
Lambda forwards log data to Graylog / Elasticsearch backend.
Athena queries raw historical logs stored directly in S3.
